reading: Recall moves 0.250 between models over identical cases, and the stronger model scores LOWER. A more capable model doing worse at a classification task is a prompt problem, not a subject problem: scripts/eval.mjs mis-specifies the routing task rather than measuring it. Until that is fixed no accuracy figure from this harness may be read as a statement about a skill, and none may be written into state/skill-registry.yaml.
supersedes_reading_of: The first full run of 613 cases on 2026-09-08 reported per-skill accuracy between 0.81 and 1.0. Those numbers stand as a record of what this harness produced and must not be quoted as skill quality.
